subject: Riverbend Park Enforcement Order
overview: The Medford Conservation Commission issued a negative wetland determination for 400 Mystic Avenue, approved a long-standing certificate of compliance, and ratified an enforcement order regarding unauthorized tree cutting at Riverbend Park.

items.title: 400 Mystic Avenue Determination of Applicability
items.summary: Issued a negative determination finding that two isolated stormwater swales near 400 Mystic Avenue are not jurisdictional under state or local wetland regulations.

items.title: Hicks Avenue and Colbert Road Certificate of Compliance
items.summary: Issued a certificate of compliance clearing a 1976 order of conditions attached to a condominium unit at Hicks Avenue and Colbert Road.

items.title: Riverbend Park Enforcement Order
items.summary: Ratified an enforcement order directing a resident to cease unauthorized tree and vegetation cutting in Riverbend Park.
